# ♥ QuickSymbols [![QuickSymbols Downloads Count](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fkamori.goats.dev%2FPlugin%2FDownloadCounts&query=%24.QuickSymbols&label=&style=plastic&color=gold)](https://kamori.goats.dev/Plugin/DownloadCounts)[![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Downloads-lightgrey?style=plastic)](https://kamori.goats.dev/Plugin/DownloadCounts) ### A quick special-symbol picker for FFXIV text fields. [![Verified Plugin - Dalamud](https://img.shields.io/badge/✔%20Verified%20Plugin-Dalamud-red?style=for-the-badge)](#) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Bryer-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discordapp.com/users/896449611168874507) [![AGPL-3.0 License](https://img.shields.io/badge/⚖️%20License-AGPL--3.0-636e72?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/LatencyBryer/QuickSymbols?tab=AGPL-3.0-1-ov-file) Adds a fast symbol picker for FFXIV chat and other text inputs. It lets you insert special characters, icons, favorites, custom entries, short snippets and optional automatic text-to-symbol replacements through a clean in-game popup.
### 📌 Summary [![Features](https://img.shields.io/badge/✨%20Features-View-00b894?style=flat-square)](#features) [![Installation](https://img.shields.io/badge/🔧%20Installation-Guide-0984e3?style=flat-square)](#installation) [![How It Works](https://img.shields.io/badge/🧠%20How%20It%20Works-Read-6c5ce7?style=flat-square)](#how-it-works) [![Supported Inputs](https://img.shields.io/badge/⌨️%20Supported%20Inputs-Check-d63031?style=flat-square)](#supported-inputs) [![IPC](https://img.shields.io/badge/🔌%20IPC-Docs-fdcb6e?style=flat-square)](#ipc-integration) [![Author](https://img.shields.io/badge/👩‍💻%20Author-Bryer-00cec9?style=flat-square)](#author) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/⚖️%20License-Info-636e72?style=flat-square)](#license) ---
### ✨ Features

♥ Quick Symbol Button

Adds a small heart button near supported FFXIV text inputs, making the symbol picker easy to open without typing commands.

The main chat button can be placed left or right of the chat controls, or hidden when you only want to use the keybind.

✨ Symbol Picker

Open a compact popup with multiple symbol categories and insert symbols directly into the active text field.

The popup stays open after clicking a symbol, so several symbols can be added quickly in a row.

⭐ Favorites & Custom Entries

Favorite symbols with CTRL + Click and keep your most used symbols at the top of the popup.

Create custom entries from the config window to save your own symbols, text or short snippets.

🎨 Theme Support

QuickSymbols can follow FFXIV UI theme colors or use Dalamud theme colors for the popup list.

Background opacity can be adjusted from transparent to opaque.

🔁 Auto Symbol Replacement

Optional vanilla-chat helper that turns small text shortcuts into real symbols while you type.

Examples include <3, :dice:, :clock:, letter markers like [a] and custom shortcuts created in the config window.

🧩 Text-to-Symbol Manager

The Chat Auto-Symbol List window shows all built-in replacements and lets you create safe custom replacements.

Custom text needs a wrapper like :name:, [name], ;name;, -name- or =name=, keeping normal words from being replaced by accident.
### Supported/Available ![ChatLog Button](https://img.shields.io/badge/ChatLog%20Button-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Party Finder](https://img.shields.io/badge/Party%20Finder-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Message Book](https://img.shields.io/badge/Housing%20Message%20Book-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![User Macros](https://img.shields.io/badge/User%20Macros-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Strategy Board](https://img.shields.io/badge/Strategy%20Board-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Keybind Popup](https://img.shields.io/badge/Keybind%20Popup-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Favorites](https://img.shields.io/badge/Favorites-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Custom Entries](https://img.shields.io/badge/Custom%20Entries-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![IPC Integration](https://img.shields.io/badge/IPC%20Integration-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Background Opacity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Background%20Opacity-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Auto Symbol Replacement](https://img.shields.io/badge/Auto%20Symbol%20Replacement-✔-gold?style=flat-square) ![Plugin Window Direct Insert](https://img.shields.io/badge/Other%20Plugins%20Window-✘-red?style=flat-square)
---
### 🔧 Dalamud Installation | Step | Action | | --- | --- | | 1️⃣ | Open the Dalamud plugin list with `/xlplugins` | | 2️⃣ | Search for `QuickSymbols` | | 3️⃣ | Click **Install** | | 4️⃣ | Enable the plugin | | ✔ | Open the picker with `/qs`, `/quicksymbols` or the configured keybind |
> [!TIP] > QuickSymbols is intended to be installed through the ingame Dalamud plugin installer only. ---
### 🧠 How It Works ### ♥ Main Chat Button QuickSymbols adds a heart button near the game's Chat and some other native windows. Clicking the button opens the symbol list. Clicking it again closes the list. The main button position can be changed in the config: _(Or manualy draging it)_ | Option | Behavior | | --- | --- | | `Left of Chat` | Places the button on the left side of the chat controls | | `Right of Chat` | Places the button on the right side of the chat controls | | `Keybind Only` | Hides the button and only uses the keybind popup | --- ### ✨ Symbol Picker Popup The popup contains several tabs for different types of symbols. | Tab | Purpose | | --- | --- | | Home | General symbols and favorites | | Numbers | Number-related symbols | | Letters | Letter/alphabet-related symbols | | Common | Commonly used symbols | | Others | Extra symbols | | Time | Time/date-related symbols | | Custom | User-created entries from the config window | --- ### ⭐ Favorites - Hold `CTRL` and click a symbol to add it to favorites. - Hold `CTRL` and click a favorite again to remove it. Favorite symbols appear in the `Favorites` section at the top of the list and are shared between all tabs/keybind-popup. --- ### 🧩 Custom Entries Custom entries are managed through the config window opened with: ```txt /qsconfig ``` Custom entries can be used for: | Type | Example | | --- | --- | | Single symbols | `★` | | Pre-made texts | `Welcome!` | | Decorative pieces | `✦ ─ ✦` | The Custom Entries input also supports opening the symbol list through the configured keybind. --- ### 🔁 Automatic Text to Symbol `Automatic replace text to symbol` is an optional vanilla-chat feature. When it is enabled, QuickSymbols watches the current vanilla chat input and replaces supported text shortcuts with their real symbols. Examples: | Typed text | Result | | --- | --- | | `<3` | `♥` | | `:dice:` | FFXIV dice symbol | | `:clock:` | FFXIV clock symbol | | `[a]` to `[z]` | FFXIV letter marker symbols | | `[1]` to `[31]` | FFXIV number marker symbols | Custom replacements can be created from the `Chat Auto-Symbol List` window in `/qsconfig`. Custom shortcut names must use one of the safe wrappers below: | Format | Example | | --- | --- | | `:name:` | `:star:` | | `[name]` | `[star]` | | `;name;` | `;star;` | | `-name-` | `-star-` | | `=name=` | `=star=` | This feature is intentionally limited to **vanilla chat only** and it will not run on messages that start with `/`, so normal commands are not rewritten. ---
### ⌨️ Supported Inputs | Input / Window | Support | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | Chat message input | ✅ Supported | Main heart button appears near chat controls | | Party Finder recruitment | ✅ Supported | Context heart button appears near the comment field | | Housing Message Book | ✅ Supported | Context heart button appears near the message field | | User Macros window | ✅ Supported | Context heart button appears below the macro text area | | Strategy Board | ✅ Supported | Context heart button appears below the text input | | Any other native window | ✅ Supported | Use the configured keybind | | Custom Entries input | ✅ Supported | Use the configured keybind inside `/qsconfig` | | Other plugins windows | 🔌 IPC Required | Use QuickSymbols IPC integration |
> For compatibility with other plugins window like `Chat2` for example, QuickSymbols needs to be integrated through IPC so the symbol list and insertion can work. --- ### ⚙️ Commands | Command | Action | | --- | --- | | `/qs` `/quicksymbols` | Opens QuickSymbols | | `/qsconfig` | Opens the QuickSymbols configuration window | --- ### 🎨 Config Options | Option | Description | | --- | --- | | Open symbol list without button | Use the configured keybind to open | | Button position | Changes the main Chat button placement | | Use Dalamud theme | Uses Dalamud colors for the popup instead of FFXIV theme | | Background opacity | Adjusts popup and symbol background opacity | | Close popup on lost focus | Closes the popup when clicking outside of it | | Automatic text to symbol | Enables vanilla chat text shortcuts such as `<3`, `:dice:` and customs | | Chat Auto-Symbol List | Opens the replacement list and custom replacement creator | | Custom Entries | Adds, edits or removes custom entries | --- ### 🔌 IPC Integration QuickSymbols exposes an IPC surface for other plugins that want to open the picker for their own ImGui inputs. | Endpoint | Type | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `QuickSymbols.GetVersion` | Function | Returns the current IPC version | | `QuickSymbols.GetHotkey` | Function | Returns the configured QuickSymbols hotkey | | `QuickSymbols.WatchInput` | Function | Marks another plugin's input as active for the QuickSymbols keybind | | `QuickSymbols.OpenPicker` | Function | Opens the picker for a specific owner key | | `QuickSymbols.ClosePicker` | Function | Closes the picker for a specific owner key | | `QuickSymbols.SymbolSelected` | Event | Sends the selected symbol back to the owner plugin | See [IPC.md](https://github.com/LatencyBryer/QuickSymbols/blob/main/IPC.md) for the full integration guide. ---
### ⚠️ Important | Rule | Status | | --- | --- | | The symbol is inserted into the currently targeted text input | ✅ Expected | | The picker can stay open after selecting a symbol | ✅ Expected | | Favorites are toggled with `CTRL + Click` | ✅ Required | | Custom entries are saved between game sessions | ✅ Saved | | Native addon pointers are re-checked before insertion | ✅ Safety | | Direct insertion into other plugin windows | ❌ IPC Required |
